## Workload

Priya Anand completed the grading workload during the review period. The record shows 855 reads undertaken across 390 hours, giving a recorded rate of 2.2 per hour. This provides a clear summary of activity and indicates the volume considered in the review. The workload figure is presented alongside the available time to support a straightforward assessment of throughput. Priya Anand was responsible for the grading and is also identified as the reviewer.

## Quality

Quality checking covered 73 cases that were read again. The recorded agreement was 67.1 per cent. This result provides the principal quality measure for the review and should be considered alongside the workload information above. Feedback was given on borderline background cases, with the additional reading used to support the assessment of consistency. The review was completed by Priya Anand, who is listed as both grader and reviewer.
